tools.description: Submit candidate misreadings of the rule: rules a solver could plausibly hold instead of the true one. Each must reproduce every demonstration shown so far and differ from the true rule on some input. A foil that contradicts a shown demonstration, or that never disagrees with the true rule, is rejected and reported back. Returns the surviving foils and the candidate inputs that refute the most of them. Free: not a demonstration.

admitted.nl: Replace every nonzero cell with 1, preserving zero background.
Change every zero cell to 1 and every nonzero cell to 0.
Copy each cell into a 2-by-2 block, enlarging both dimensions by two.
Transpose the grid across its main diagonal.
Replace each cell by its color complement 9 minus its value.
Move every nonzero cell one position to the right, dropping cells that leave the grid.
Replace each cell by the most frequent color in its row, preserving the grid dimensions.
